data.name: Janvikansh
data.gender_notes: Janvikansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Janvikansh is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Jan' meaning 'God' and 'Vikansh' meaning 'Grace' or 'Blessing'. It represents the divine grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods. The name Janvikansh carries the meaning “God's Grace, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Janvikansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The Janvikas clan was a powerful and prosperous Yadav dynasty that ruled parts of the present-day Uttar Pradesh and Bihar regions in ancient India from around the 6th to the 12th centuries AD.
Janmajayasinh, a Jain ruler of the Janvikas dynasty, is said to have ruled from around 1065 to 1095 AD and is known for his patronage of Jain scholars and institutions.

It signifies a commitment to providing assistance and support to customers or investors, and is a reflection of the entrepreneurial spirit and innovative mindset that is prevalent in the Indian startup ecosystem.
